description: This is a comprehensive Lua test script that verifies multiple aspects of Lua interpreter behavior, including command-line options, environment variable handling, file operations, error handling, warnings, signal handling, and more. It serves as an extensive test suite for the Lua interpreter functionality.

methods.name: prepfile
methods.description: Writes a string or binary data to a temporary file to be used in subsequent tests.

methods.name: getoutput
methods.description: Reads the output from a temporary file capturing command execution results.

methods.name: checkprogout
methods.description: Checks that the program output matches expected output.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Validates that the actual output matches expected results.

methods.name: RUN
methods.description: Executes a given Lua command or script with formatted arguments.

methods.name: NoRun
methods.description: Asserts that execution of a command fails and outputs the expected error message.
